paragraphs.heading: What is real freedom?
paragraphs.edited: I think one of the greatest lies and confusions of our age deals with the question of what is freedom. Have you ever thought in your life, what is real freedom? When I ask students to define freedom, typically they'll say to me, freedom is when you can do whatever you want to do as long as nobody is telling you how to live your life. If it feels good, do it, and you're free. Friends, that's not freedom. Living according to whatever feels good is going to enslave you to your passions. Real freedom is when we embrace God's design for our life, which is to love him and to love other people.
